messages:
sara: heads up 101010 working on the models gallery keyboard flow. current "snap-to-column" Tab behaviour is causing SR chatter and focus jumps. anyone else seen this?

lee: saw it on staging. Tab sometimes lands on a visually shifted card after the grid repaints. focus outline also disappears on dark theme.

morgan: quick theory 101010 transforms on resize are moving elements, so the UA focus rect thinks the element moved. fix: keep element position in layout and avoid CSS translate on focus. use box-shadow for emphasis.

sara: agreed. also we need to decide keyboard model: do we want linear Tab or 2D arrow navigation? mixing both is confusing.

morgan: recommend keyboard patterns: Tab enters/exits the grid (single Tab stop for the whole gallery), Arrow keys move within the grid, Home/End move to first/last, PageUp/PageDown jump by rows. implement roving tabindex to keep DOM order and manage tabindex=-1/current=0.

lee: for screen reader announcements, prefer concise text: "Model: <name>, <index> of <total>, <status>". avoid timestamps and extra metadata. add aria-posinset/aria-setsize on gridcell.

a11y-bot: scan result: focus-outline (dark) contrast ratio 3:1; threshold 4.5:1. Issue A11Y-509 created.

sara: copy nit: for the live region use polite and debounce 250ms to avoid repeated announcements during quick arrow nav.

morgan: will prototype and push a demo branch. will include a11y notes in PR description.

sara: add a visible helper: small hint above grid "Use Arrow keys to navigate, Enter to open" and an offscreen hint for screen readers that describes controls when the grid receives focus.

lee: perfect. thanks team. I'll follow up on the CSS token change for focus color.
